svg.title: FC Rocher
svg.desc: FC Rocher (FR-6), Monaco. Original vector crest with mathematically mirrored shield, angular lower vertex, armillary sphere, diagonal band, eight editable layers. Official colors: #9F4A4E and #FFFFFF.
